hooks.command: [ -n "$MDGRAPH_VAULT" ] && python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mdgraph.py" query index --depth 1 --vault "$MDGRAPH_VAULT" 2>/dev/null | jq -Rs --arg p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mdgraph.py" --arg v "$MDGRAPH_VAULT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("[mdgraph] Карта знаний vault (автозагрузка). Скрипт: " + $p + " | vault: " + $v + "\n\n" + .)}}'; true
